text:
Anna (Finance): Quick approval request — one-time reseller commission override + payout deferral for EdgeResell on MapleHealth pilot. Deal: $120,000 TCV, pilot milestone at 90 days. Requesting 20% override on first $120k (one-off) and defer payout until milestone (90d). Reason: partner is fronting discount to close quickly, this reduces Redwood sales lift risk. Ticket FIN-4421. cc @Sam (Sales) @Mike (CFO)
Sam (Sales): Can you attach the reseller agreement amendment? Also who owns the co-sell / CS handoff? Does this change our listed ASP or require markdown approval?
Anna (Finance): Sent the amendment draft to #legal earlier — waiting on signature. CS handoff stays with the Enterprise CSM team. This is a one-time commercial concession, not a price book change.
Jess (RevOps): Quick calc below — formatted to show net impact:
```
TCV: $120,000
Requested override: 20% of $120,000 = $24,000 commission hit
Net revenue recognized initially: $96,000 (subject to deferral rules)
Payout is deferred ~90d, potential clawback if pilot fails
```
Jess (RevOps): Suggest adding a clawback clause: full clawback within 6 months if contract not converted to enterprise. Also recommend capping total partner concessions to 25% of first-year ARR across pilot deals.
Sam (Sales): Sounds fine to me if legal + CSM commit to the milestone. We need partner SOW signed before Redwood recognizes any revenue.
Mike (CFO): I can approve a partial concession here. Approve up to 15% one-time override and payout deferral to 90 days, provided: 1) written amendment with clawback, 2) Legal signs off, 3) Revenue hold until milestone met. 20% is too high for me without further risk mitigations.
Anna (Finance): Noted — will update request to 15% override per CFO. I'll add clawback language and queue for legal signoff.
Jess (RevOps): I'll update FIN-4421 with the new numbers and add the clawback/CS milestone. Also adding a follow-up to monitor conversion at 90/180 days.
DealBot: FIN-4421 updated by Jess (RevOps) — status: Approved (partial). Override set to 15%, payout deferred 90d, legal signoff required.
Anna (Finance): Thanks everyone — proceeding with amendment and legal intake. Will post final signed doc here once complete. :thumbsup:
